messages:
maya-csm: Heads-up: Nimbus QBR next Tue. Onboarding spike - embeddings traffic jumped overnight. Can we carve out 15m to triage a short-term budget gate and add a mitigation slide? :wave:
owen-finops: I looked at the billing feed. Their median tokens/day was ~2k, jumped to ~46k for new cohort. If sustained, projected add'l monthly spend ~ $6k. Recommend temporary soft cap + staggered alerts. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam-embed-ops: Two quick levers: enable batching on batch-embed endpoint (low friction) and prefix-KV caching for recurring prompts (better ROI but needs testing). For QBR immediate: provisional per-account soft-cap + alerting. Adaptive batching is next sprint.
sarah-qa: If we flip a cap, I need the expected error contract so clients can handle it. Do we return 429 + header X-Soft-Throttle? Also need test vectors for ingest vs realtime paths.
maya-csm: Proposed: daily cap 55k, alerts at 50/80/95%, soft-throttle at 90% with an override for product-led demos. I will notify Nimbus and add to the QBR slide.
owen-finops: Draft alert config (engineerable?) - copy below:
alerts.daily_cap=55000; thresholds=[50,80,95]; soft_throttle=90; notify=[maya-csm,owen-finops]; escalate_if_over_120pct_for_2h -> pager.
liam-embed-ops: Works for us. Soft-throttle will return 429 JSON: {"code":"soft_throttle","allowed_remaining":...} and header X-Soft-Throttle: 1. We'll gate behind a feature flag and enable for Nimbus first. Batching toggle is a config on the batch endpoint; can be enabled immediately.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-embed-guard-3222223333. Notifs to #customer-success and owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Appreciate the quick reaction. We'll send our top-10 prompts and expected concurrency by EOD. Can you enable batching on the batch endpoint? That will help smooth spikes while you tune caching.
maya-csm: Liam + Sarah - please add a 5-point test checklist and the error contract to the shared QBR doc (https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus). Owen - can you add a conservative spend table and a short renewal-risk note?
owen-finops: Adding projection: baseline MRR stable; near-term renewal risk = low-medium due to unexpected onboarding spend. I'll put conservative and optimistic scenarios into the deck and mark the mitigation timeline.
maya-csm: Goal: close triage and lock temporary guardrails before Friday so QBR slide shows action items. Thanks team :thumbsup:
